subject: CloudPeak replacement: commercial counter + packaging options
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@cloudpeak.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.p@cloudpeak.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudpeak.com>
Date: 2027-06-09T08:12:00Z
Subject: Redwood: can you match the current incumbent + migration support?

Marissa —

Quick one from our side: our incumbent (EdgeLayer) just sent a counter that preserves our current seat-based effective unit price and includes a 3-month migration credit (equivalent to ~$120k) plus hands-on ops support for the cutover window.

We like Redwood's runtime and observability, but the commercial delta is material. Can Redwood mirror the incumbent for base seats and offer a defined migration assistance bucket? If so, we can accelerate approval and I can get legal to prioritize the redline.

Also, a couple quick constraints from our SRE team: must support private VPC deployment and rolling canaries during cutover.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

—Oliver
VP Product, CloudPeak Solutions
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@cloudpeak.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-09T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood: can you match the current incumbent + migration support?

Oliver — thanks for the context and the transparency. We can do a couple of structured paths depending on how CloudPeak wants to trade up-front vs run-rate: 

- Option A (feature-aligned parity): match incumbent effective seat price for 12 months, provide a $120k migration credit applied over the first two invoices, and include two onsite/remote runbooks days + 40 hours of dedicated EngOps support for the cutover window. Requires 12-month commit.

- Option B (risk-reduction bundle): 10% discount off our list, $80k migration credit, 60 days of extended onboarding (includes canary plan + workload benchmarking) and a tech escrow for the first 90 days. No minimum term beyond standard 12-month MRR cadence.

Both options support Private (VPC) deployment and staged canary rollouts — we’ll include a SOW that spells out rollback gates and SLA credits. I’ve attached a short offer packet and a migration scenario workbook to help model economics.

If you want to proceed, Connor can prep a precise invoice-level view; Jonas should weigh in on how we structure credit recognition for accounting.

Available for a 30m call today 1–3pm PT or tomorrow morning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood-Offer-vA.pdf; CloudPeak-Migration-Scenario.xlsx
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-09T11:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood: can you match the current incumbent + migration support?

Marissa — good framing. Two quick clarifications from pricing ops: 

1) If we do Option A (seat parity + $120k credit), I recommend tying the credit to go-live milestones (30% on contract signing, 40% on pilot completion, 30% on production cutover) to avoid revenue recognition timing issues.

2) We should gate the onsite/remote days to an agreed SOW so they don’t become an open-ended expense. Suggest line items: 2x runbook days (8 hrs each), 40 hours EngOps (hourly overage rate listed).

Connor — can you produce a line-item view and updated quote we can attach to the DocuSign envelope?

—Jonas
VP, Commercial Operations
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@cloudpeak.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-10T09:16:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood: can you match the current incumbent + migration support?

Oliver — attaching the worksheet with invoice-level view and two sample line-item SOWs (light-touch + deep-cutover). Highlights from the quote:

- Option A: Effective seat price match (12mo), migration credit $120,000 disbursed across milestones, SOW line items called out.
- Option B: 10% list discount, $80,000 credit, extended onboarding items.

Attachments: SOW-migration-outline.docx; CloudPeak-Migration-Scenario.xlsx

If that looks good I can drop these into a DocuSign package and tag the HubSpot deal (RDW-4729) for legal review.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@cloudpeak.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Oliver Grant <oliver@cloudpeak.com>
Date: 2027-06-12T16:44:00Z
Subject: Re: Redwood: can you match the current incumbent + migration support?

Marissa / Connor — thanks for the quick turnaround. A few legal/Procurement asks before we can route to approval: 

- Please confirm data residency commitments and whether audit logs (readable by customer) will be retained for 13 months.
- Need a sample DPA with standard EU SCCs (we will need this for our compliance team even though initial deployment is in US).
- Include a clear acceptance test for the migration milestone (SRE sign-off criteria).

Oliver — once Redwood provides those items I’ll fast-track redlines. If you want, schedule a joint session with our SREs to review the canary plan.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Sr. Counsel, CloudPeak Solutions
